immunology.best_potency_assay: CHEMBL5365708 — TYK2 JH2 575-869 tracer displacement, compound CHEMBL5427107

approved_small_molecules.name: Deucravacitinib
approved_small_molecules.mechanism: TYK2 negative allosteric modulator (JH2 pseudokinase domain)

domain_split.other: 1 spans JH2+JH1, 2 are the 1048-1062 fragment, 1 is FERM-through-JH2 (23-583)

immunology.why_in_set: The non-obvious pocket. Deucravacitinib binds the pseudokinase JH2 domain, not the ATP site. The allosteric site was structurally enabled ~3 years AFTER the conventional one, and approval followed the first JH2 structure by ~9 years.

expected_output.as_of_2012_12_31: no allosteric precedent — JH2 structures do not exist yet
expected_output.as_of_2015_12_31: allosteric precedent EXISTS — must not report absence
expected_output.note: best as-of test in the set: it tests a POCKET appearing, not just a drug

immunology.why_in_set: THE TRAP, and the highest-value row in the set. Three approved antibodies all reporting action_type INHIBITOR with NULL canonical_smiles. Verified live: an agent reading drugs_by_accession concludes 'three approved inhibitors' and is wrong.

expected_output.biologic_precedent: three approved antibodies, reported separately and never as small-molecule precedent
expected_output.nuance_required: potent small molecules DO exist (0.79 nM) but none approved and one Phase 1 terminated for DILI. Neither 'druggable, 3 approved drugs' nor 'no small molecules exist' is correct.
expected_output.signal: 117 distinct compounds vs RORgt's 12,900 despite far greater commercial pull — the gap is itself evidence of difficulty
expected_output.structural_note: the small-molecule/macrocycle site was only elucidated in 2016 (5HI3), ~1 year AFTER the first antibody approval. Precedent and tractability are out of phase.

immunology.class_risk: RORg1/RORgt cross-reactivity and thymic/T-cell lymphoma risk
immunology.why_in_set: Tractability != success. 152 holo structures, 12,900 compounds, 0.1 nM potency, ZERO approvals — failure was toxicity, not chemistry. Any agent scoring on pocket quality alone gets this wrong.

expected_output.must_state: tractable AND repeatedly failed clinically for tox — these are not in tension, and clinical failure is NOT evidence against druggability

THE_CONFLICT.dominant_assay: IRAK4 Monocyte TNFalpha Cell Based Assay
THE_CONFLICT.problem: that assay measures a DIFFERENT TARGET (IRAK4) with TNF as the cellular readout. Naive precedent retrieval reads thousands of potent TNF actives; almost none are direct binders.

slot_5_precedent_structure_conflict.best_potency_caveat: Ki 0.03 nM (CHEMBL3640299, assay CHEMBL3705047) description is only 'Inhibition assay using TNF-alpha' — UNCHARACTERIZED
slot_5_precedent_structure_conflict.best_credible_direct_binding: Kd 1.3 nM (CHEMBL4793441, assay CHEMBL4775686, SPR vs biotinylated TNF-alpha trimer 77-233)
slot_5_precedent_structure_conflict.structure_caveat: SPD304 is a bis-electrophilic compound widely regarded as a promiscuous/cytotoxic frequent hitter. There IS a holo structure and it is exactly the misleading kind.
slot_5_precedent_structure_conflict.why_in_set: Carries THREE failure modes at once: modality trap (5 approved biologics, 0 small molecules), assay artifact (45% of bioactivity is a different target's assay), and misleading structure (holo ligand is a known frequent hitter). Also the second pocket-detection regime — a cavity PRESENT BUT SMALL in the apo trimer, versus KRAS where it is absent.
slot_5_precedent_structure_conflict.backup: STAT3 (P40763, CHEMBL4026) — 2,370 compounds, best IC50 2.4 nM, only 6 PDB entries and 3 holo, top assays are EMSA/ChIP/reporter. Better if we want thin structural evidence rather than misleading evidence.

slot_6_recent_orphan.chembl_id_note: very high target ID, i.e. recently created
slot_6_recent_orphan.assay_provenance: ALL 15 from a single assay CHEMBL6115567, 'Binding affinity to CAP chip-immobilized IL-11', all assay_type B
slot_6_recent_orphan.why_in_set: The right shape for insufficient_evidence: JUST enough data to tempt a confident score (a 140 nM Kd exists) while single-assay provenance, 15 compounds, and no clinical program make any confident call unjustified.

expected_output.must_not: produce a confident tractability number from a 15-compound single-assay screening series

slot_6_recent_orphan.OPEN_CAVEAT: The 'proposed in the last 3 years' framing was NOT independently verified against a primary source. ChEMBL target-ID recency and the 15-activity footprint are retrieved; the timeline is inference. Confirm against the 2024 Nature IL-11/healthspan literature before locking this fixture.
